subject: af-td
title: AF.TD.------POST.
description: Chart on book p. 228 (T(IMP)M-26). AF-TD (affinity tendencies) is the subject; POST (postulation) is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics), ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) and INFO-DY. From SOC-RT-DY: RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From ALT-FT: ALT-ACT (alternative activism). From ALT-ACT: CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism). From INFO-DY: CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis) and ATTN (attraction). From CULT-AF-B: MD-DY (media dynamics). From ATTN: ASP-ES (aspect essence). A further line from the RT-ALGN line ends at a dot with no label.
